title.en: Antenna basics and the half-wave dipole

body.en: An antenna converts RF current into electromagnetic waves (transmitting) and back (receiving); by reciprocity its properties are the same both ways. The basic resonant antenna is the *half-wave dipole*: two conductors of total length $\lambda/2$ fed at the centre. Its radiation pattern is a figure of eight in a plane containing the dipole (maximum perpendicular to it, zero along its axis) and a circle in the plane perpendicular to it. A vertical quarter-wave (Marconi) antenna over the ground acts like a half-wave dipole.

points.en: Pattern: figure of eight, null along the axis
Reciprocity: same for TX and RX

narration.en: An antenna changes RF current into waves and back. The half-wave dipole is half a wavelength long and radiates most strongly at right angles to its length.
narration.kn: ಆಂಟೆನಾ RF ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ಕಾಂತೀಯ ತರಂಗಗಳಾಗಿ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅರ್ಧ-ತರಂಗ ಡೈಪೋಲ್‌ನ ಉದ್ದ λ/2; ಅದು ತನ್ನ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Dipole and Yagi antennas

say.en: The half-wave dipole: two rods, fed at the centre, with a total length of half a wavelength.
It radiates most broadside to the rods and nothing along them, so its pattern is a figure of eight.
Its length is c over 2 f. At 200 megahertz the wavelength is 1.5 metres, so the dipole is 0.75 metre long.
The Yagi-Uda antenna adds a longer reflector behind the dipole and shorter directors in front. The beam points towards the directors.
For satellites and radar, a parabolic dish focuses waves onto a feed at its focus, giving a very narrow, high-gain beam.
On the board: Dipole and Yagi antennas.

narration.en: A half-wave dipole is λ/2 long, fed at the centre. The current (orange) is largest at the centre and zero at the ends; the voltage (blue) is largest at the ends. It radiates most broadside and nothing along its own axis (the figure-of-eight pattern). A quarter-wave monopole over the ground gives the same current pattern above ground.
narration.kn: ಅರ್ಧ-ತರಂಗ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ λ/2 ಉದ್ದ, ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೋಷಣೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶೂನ್ಯ; ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ. ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಿಕಿರಣ, ಅಕ್ಷದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.

body.en: The Yagi–Uda antenna has a driven element (usually a folded dipole), a reflector about 5% longer placed behind it, and one or more directors slightly shorter placed in front. The parasitic elements make the beam point towards the directors, giving gain and directivity; it is used for TV reception. At microwave frequencies a parabolic dish reflects waves to a feed at its focus, giving a very narrow, high-gain beam for satellite links and radar.

points.en: Dish: feed at the focus, very high gain

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find the length of a a half-wave dipole and b a quarter-wave vertical antenna for an FM station at 100 megahertz.
lambda equals c over f equals 3 times 10 to the power 8 divided by 100 times 10 to the power 6 equals 3 metres.
a Half-wave dipole equals lambda /2 equals 1.5 metres.
b Quarter-wave antenna equals lambda /4 equals 0.75 metres.
So the answer is 1.5 metres and 0.75 metres.
